title: Fireside Reading Nook

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min while you settle in with a book.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist linens lightly, not skin.

why_it_works: Bergamot's bright citrus softens resinous frankincense and dry cedarwood, creating a warm, grounded hush that suits slow autumn reading.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
